metadata.current: Working source snapshot at process start
metadata.statistic: Conventional median: arithmetic mean of the two central values for even sample counts; raw ordered runs are retained.
metadata.scope: Uninstrumented synchronous Node CPU fitting using shared preloaded geometry. No GLB/texture decoding, animation setup, GPU/FPS or browser route timing.
metadata.coldDefinition: After baseline/current warmup pairs, clear only that environment's bounded wardrobeFitCache before each cache-cold preparation; other module/source/JIT caches remain warm.
metadata.warmDefinition: Same environment and look immediately after its preceding cache-cold run; geometry validation and disposal occur between runs, outside measured intervals.
metadata.ordering: Even rounds: baseline cold/warm then current cold/warm. Odd rounds reverse the two environment pairs.
metadata.baselineScope: Separate Vite SSR contexts over immutable baseline/current frontend/src and wardrobe-catalog snapshots. Tracked dependency manifests, Vite setup and catalog inputs must match baseline. Installed dependencies and currently materialized assets are shared, not reconstructed historical installs; asset hashes identify these exact inputs.
metadata.equivalenceScope: Original accepted fixture digest plus a baseline digest of morph buffers, mesh transforms/bind matrices, skeleton names/inverses and skirtHandRoom. UUIDs, material/texture behavior, bounding caches and GPU upload counters are excluded.
metadata.fixtureScope: Accepted tier fixtures keep their historical actor tier. The separate default-desktop oracle uses baseline production resolution: portrait actor plus garage skirt/corset, ReadyVillager-equivalent options; it does not extend visual acceptance.

oracle.acceptance: Separate production-resolver baseline oracle; not visual acceptance
